summary_md:
# 86. Hausse in Beijing

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a solo episode that is mostly a political and market-structure rant. The host mocks election-season outrage and the FH financial journalism awards, criticises how illiquid the Swedish small-cap market has become, and proposes delisting 'junk' companies or bundling them into ETFs. The trading commentary describes a dead, low-turnover Swedish market: the host has been buying Volati, shorted a spike in Net Insight after a small defence order, and missed Acconeer. He has taken a small contrarian position in Take-Two ahead of GTA 6 and calls Lululemon a value trap.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TTWO — Take-Two Interactive | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host bought a small 'alibi' position after a ~16% drop on GTA 6 leaks, planning to hold into the launch.

#### Reasoning

Host argues leaks cannot judge the full game and that delays are positive in gaming. He thinks bank analysts cutting targets are wrong, and that this is an inverted setup: the stock fell into the launch instead of rising, so sell-the-news risk is lower.

#### Sell Triggers

- GTA 6 launch is buggy or poorly received
- after launch (sell-on-news)
- further estimate cuts backed by real sales data

> *"Jag har köpt en liten LOL-posse, en alibi position i Take-Two och tänker att man kan hålla det inför lanseringen."*

---

### 🟢 VOLO — Volati | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host says he bought a fair amount of Volati in a quiet market.

#### Reasoning

Host is buying Volati mostly out of boredom in a dead market. No fundamental thesis given.

#### Sell Triggers

- no thesis stated

> *"Jag köpte en hel del Volati"*

---

### 🔴 NETI-B — Net Insight | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host shorted an up to +18% spike on a SEK 5m defence order against ~SEK 1bn market cap; the stock gapped down the next days.

#### Reasoning

The order is tiny relative to market cap and margins are unknown, so host saw a 7–18% move as irrational buying by traders. He averaged into the short as the stock rose, was proven right when it fell 4% then 8–9%, and still views the move as dumb.

#### Sell Triggers

- time-sync defence segment shows material growth
- larger follow-on defence orders

> *"Så jag gick emot och så gick aktien upp 10-11%."*

---

### ⛔ LULU — Lululemon | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down ~22% on its report; EPS beat helped by tariff refunds; brand losing hype. Host calls it a value trap.

#### Reasoning

Host sees fading brand hype and possible product problems. He says the EPS beat was flattered by tariff refunds, rising dividends plus discounting look like a value trap, and fashion brands (Dr Martens, Ed Hardy, Abercrombie) lose share to new trends.

#### Sell Triggers

- genuine earnings growth without one-offs
- brand momentum recovers

> *"Och nu blir det en liten, alltså det blir en value trap i den här aktien."*

---

### ⛔ PEPTON — Peptonic Medical | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Called a company that should not exist: an issue machine with no working product that bought shares in scam company Intelligo.

#### Reasoning

Host views it as a serial share-issuer with ~SEK 100m market cap, no functioning product and poor capital allocation (buying a stake in Intelligo). He thinks it harms retail investors.

#### Sell Triggers

- working commercial product
- end of dilutive share issues

> *"Peptonic Medical. Återigen ett bolag som bara, det ska bara inte finnas."*

---

### ⛔ CAT-B — Catella | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Used as an example of an unappealing stock whose turnaround is always eight quarters away.

#### Reasoning

Host says retail investors reasonably prefer winning stocks over Catella, whose recovery keeps being pushed eight quarters out. A passing remark, not a detailed thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- visible turnaround in results

> *"Man vill inte köpa Catella. Som säger att om åtta kvartal vänder det."*

---

### ⛔ NKE — Nike | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host likes the products but says the stock keeps falling as fickle consumers switch brands.

#### Reasoning

Host's broader view is that consumers are fickle and brands lose hype and share. Nike's falling stock and constant sales are good for consumers but bad for shareholders.

#### Sell Triggers

- brand demand recovers

> *"Jag har nästan bara Nike-kläder på gymmet, men aktien håller på att sprängas varje dag."*
